title: 'Draw This, Then Die!' Anime's 1st Promo Video Reveals Opening Theme Song, July 3 Premiere
content: The official website for the television anime of Minoru Toyoda 's Draw This, Then Die! ( Kore Kaite Shine ) manga began streaming the first promotional video on Friday, and it announces the anime's July 3 premiere. The trailer reveals and previews the opening theme song "Isho" by Tatsuya Kitani .
author: ANN

title: After 72 Years, Godzilla’s Best Movie Isn’t an Easy Answer Even for Die Hard Fans
content: Godzilla has, as of the writing of this article, thirty-eight movies under his titanic belt. The King of the Monsters was originally quarantined to Japan, but eventually would find his way to North America thanks to quite a few projects.
author: ComicBook

title: One of Anime’s Best Movie is Returning to Theaters
content: While television series can often be seen as the bread and butter of the anime world, anime movies are becoming a huge deal in theaters. Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle scored hundreds of millions of dollars at the box office, with countless other anime films scoring serious profits.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Quest, Silent Hill Inducted into 2026 Video Game Hall of Fame
content: The Strong National Museum of Play in Rochester, New York announced the 2026 inductees to its Video Game Hall of Fame on Thursday, This year's inductees include Dragon Quest (1986), Silent Hill (1999), Angry Birds (2009), and FIFA International Soccer (1993).
author: ANN

title: GKIDS Screens New 4K Remaster of Tekkonkinkreet Anime Film in N. America for 20th Anniversary
content: Tekkonkinkreet centers on two orphans named Black and White, living in Treasure Town, a slum-like town that is overrun by rampant crime. A Yakuza boss named Snake is aiming to demolish Treasure Town to build a theme park, but Black interferes with their operations. The anime film debuted in 2006.
author: ANN

title: Cartoon Network Revival Changes Major Character
content: While Cartoon Network is still creating original content to this day, the cable network hasn’t been shy when it comes to revisiting some of its biggest franchises. Later this month, Regular Show is bringing back Mordecai, Rigby, and the other park employees with Regular Show: The Lost Tapes .
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Launches Premium Membership Sale for Ani-May
content: Crunchyroll announced today that it will be offering a limited time discounted Premium membership offer for Ani-May. The company celebrates everything there is in the world of anime during May across streaming, gaming, retail, and real-world experiences.
author: Anime Corner

title: Devil May Cry Season 2 Reveals Animated MV for New Single by Papa Roach
content: Devil May Cry Season 2 revealed an animated music video featuring a new single “See U in Hell” by Papa Roach ft. Hanumankind. The sequel is set to release exclusively on Netflix on May 12, 2026. Papa Roach’s “Last Resort” was previously used in a trailer for Season 1.
author: Anime Corner

title: Jujutsu Kaisen is Now a Part of the Marvel Universe
content: Marvel and manga have crossed over quite a bit in recent years, with Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man meeting Ultraman, Deadpool teaming up with My Hero Academia’s All Might, and even the Avengers fighting against the monstrosities of Attack on Titan .
author: ComicBook
